Completion, for a client that reads Markdown and snippets: the
functions after "::" and "->", the names a callback's string can have,
the files of an #include and the objects of an inherit statement, with
what each item replaces; the comment above a declaration when the item
is asked for; and what a trigger character gets where it begins nothing.

-- lib/dgdtools.yml --
root: .
driver_config: mud.dgd
-- lib/mud.dgd --
include_dirs = ({ "/include" });
-- lib/include/std.h --
#define BASE "/std/base"
-- lib/include/sys/types.h --
-- lib/std/base.c --
/*
 * Sets the weight.
 */
varargs void set_weight(int grams, string why...) {}
void create() {}
static void quiet() {}
-- lib/obj/a.c --
#include <std.h>
inherit BASE;
/* blåbær 🫐 */ void create() { ::create(); "/std/base"->set_weight(1); call_out("create", 1); }
void f(object ob, int n) { ob->create(); n = n > 1 ? n : 2; }
-- script --
initialize lib
open lib/obj/a.c
# after "::", in the middle of the name: the inherited functions
complete lib/obj/a.c 2:35
resolve 2
# after "->" on a path: what a call from outside reaches
complete lib/obj/a.c 2:57 >
# in a callback's string: the object's own functions, as names
complete lib/obj/a.c 2:84
# on a receiver nobody knows: nothing
complete lib/obj/a.c 3:31 >
# a '>' and a ':' that begin nothing
complete lib/obj/a.c 3:48 >
complete lib/obj/a.c 3:56 :
# paths
complete lib/obj/a.c 0:10 <
complete lib/obj/a.c 0:12
change lib/obj/a.c 1:8-1:12 "\"/std/"
complete lib/obj/a.c 1:14 /
shutdown
exit
